resources.string: While a focus is running, Focus reacts when you open an app from your list. It does nothing during breaks or when the timer is stopped.
Needed to know which app is open.
When I open a listed app
A short notification reminds you that you are in a focus. The app stays open.
A block screen covers the app until the focus ends. You can always go back to the timer or stop it.
Without \"Display over other apps\", Focus warns instead of blocking.
Focus has no internet access. The list and the open app are checked on this phone and never saved or sent.
Usage access is an Android permission that lets an app see which app is in the foreground.
Focus only checks it while a focus is running, about once a second, and compares it with your list.
Nothing is recorded or leaves your phone. Focus does not even have permission to use the internet.
You can turn it off at any time in the same system screen.
Next: Android opens its settings. Find Focus and turn on \"Permit usage access\", then come back.
To cover another app, Android requires \"Display over other apps\".
Focus uses it only to open its own block page during a focus. It never draws on top of other apps otherwise.
Next: Android opens its settings. Turn on \"Allow display over other apps\" for Focus, then come back.
%1$s is on your list. %2$d min left, you have got this.
%s is on your list of apps to avoid. It will be available again when this focus ends.
Because Focus was installed from an APK file instead of a store, Android greys this option out for safety (\"restricted setting\"). Only you can allow it:
Tap the ⋮ menu in the top right corner.
Choose \"Allow restricted settings\" and confirm with your PIN or fingerprint.
Come back and tap \"I allowed it\" to turn on usage access.
Next: Android opens the app info for Focus. Tap the ⋮ menu, choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then turn on usage access.
Without usage access, Focus reminds you whenever you leave it during a focus, in any app.
You left Focus in the middle of a focus. %1$d min to go, come back when you can.
